records.name: Prime residue-number arithmetic
records.summary: Prime RNS profiles for exact unsigned 256-by-256-bit products, coordinate-major table-amortized batches, and fixed-modulus witness-hinted reduction, including both a compact externally bound verifier and a standalone globally bound verifier.
records.security: Each combined modulus is composite, so exact-integer semantics require a proved expression bound. The coordinate-only hinted profiles, including the 42-prime carry verifier, are conditional on external global bindings for every supplied vector. The standalone 36-prime profile instead range-checks four shared 16-limb values, derives their canonical residues with exact binding carries, proves lhs, rhs, and remainder below the target, and checks the product relation locally.
records.stack_contract: The no-carry profile uses 75 canonical residues and contiguous vectors. Its batch API consumes coordinate-major operand pairs and leaves coordinate-major products on the altstack. The conditional carry profile consumes 42 coordinate-interleaved groups lhs_i | rhs_i | q_i | r_i | [complement_i] | carry_i and returns 42 remainder residues. The standalone profile consumes 64 centered limbs followed by 36 five-carry groups and returns 16 centered remainder limbs beneath 36 canonical remainder residues.
